query:
-- Logs de acesso recentes da Cintia
SELECT al.userId, al.acao, al.createdAt, u.role, u.tenantId, u.perfil
FROM accessLogs al
JOIN users u ON u.id = al.userId
WHERE u.email = 'cintia.mezanini@gmail.com'
ORDER BY al.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Verificar qual ID tem o APP_COOKIE mais recente (via lastSignedIn se existir)
SELECT id, name, email, role, perfil, tenantId, ativo, empresaVinculada
FROM users
WHERE email = 'cintia.mezanini@gmail.com'
ORDER BY id;
